note: SYNTHETIC. Every alert in this file was hand-authored for a demonstration. No camera, collar, or barn sensor produced any of these readings, and HerdRelay ships no code path that ingests real animal data. The animals, pens, and site are fictional.

alerts.evidenceSummary: Elevated flank movement over 11 minutes of continuous footage, with the animal standing apart from the group and head held low.
Breathing rate above range across two short clips, separated by a period within range. Partial occlusion by a feed rail for much of the window.
Sustained elevation for 19 minutes after the herd settled, with reduced movement compared with the animal's own overnight baseline.
Brief rate spike during a feed push, returning to range within four minutes. Consistent with routine activity rather than an incident.
